blocks.title: Therapeutic window
blocks.text: Therapeutic window plasma mein dawa ke un concentrations ki had hai jo nuqsan-deh zimni asraat (side effects) ke baghair mo'assar hon. Yeh dawa ka 'behtareen hissa' hai: itna kam nahi ke be-asar ho aur itna zyada nahi ke khatarnak ho.

items: Minimum effective concentration (MEC): dawa ki woh kam tareen satah jis se neeche woh ilaji asar nahi deti.
Minimum toxic concentration (MTC): woh kam tareen satah jis par dawa nuqsan-deh asraat ya 'zehr' dena shuru karti hai.
Duration of action: woh waqt jab tak dawa ka concentration therapeutic window ke andar rehta hai.

blocks.text: Chauri therapeutic window ka matlab hai ke dawa ki hifazati hudood kushada hain, kyunke kaam karne wali aur nuqsan dene wali khurak mein bara faasla hai; is se khurak mein zyada gunjaish milti hai. Tang window ka matlab hai dawa kam mehfooz hai, kyunke mo'assar khurak zehreeli khurak ke bohat qareeb hai. Doctors ko aisi dawayein likhte waqt bohat ehtiyat karni parti hai aur aksar mareez ka khoon check karna parta hai taake dawa ki satah tang had ke andar rahe. Kai dawayein aik saath lena, genetic awamil, motapa, umar ya aam sehat bhi dawa ki therapeutic window badal sakte hain, kyunke yeh dawa ke metabolism aur asar par asar dalte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: khurak ke muqable jawab dene wale mareezon ki feesad ke do S-numa curves: efficacy (neela) pehle uthta, ED50 nishan zada; toxicity (surkh) zyada khurak par uthta, TD50 nishan zada; darmiyan sabz patti therapeutic window hai, aur TI = TD50/ED50. Neeche: aik khurak ke baad khoon mein dawa ki satah uth kar girti hai; surkh dashed lakeer MTC aur sabz dashed lakeer MEC dikhati; darmiyani patti therapeutic window hai, aur teer duration of action dikhata jab satah MEC se oopar ho.
blocks.caption: Therapeutic window aur therapeutic index (Figure 32.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Dawa tab faida deti jab us ki satah MEC se oopar ho aur nuqsan tab jab MTC se oopar chali jaye. Efficacy aur toxicity curves jitne door hon, window utni chauri aur dawa utni mehfooz.

blocks.prompt: Dawa ke duration of action se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh waqt jab tak khoon mein dawa ka concentration us ki therapeutic window, yani MEC aur MTC ke darmiyan, rehta hai.

items: Therapeutic window: plasma satahein jo nuqsan ke baghair kaam karein.
MEC: is se neeche asar nahi; MTC: is se oopar zehreela.
Tang window: dawa ki satah ki nigrani zaruri.
